name: What is the difference between stock cabinets and custom cabinetry?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between stock cabinets and custom cabinetry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom cabinetry is built to the exact dimensions of your room, whereas stock cabinets come in fixed, factory-standard sizes with three-inch increments. The primary tradeoff comes down to flexibility versus upfront lead time. Stock units often leave unused gaps that require wide filler strips, limiting your storage potential. Built-to-order cabinets allow craftsmen to maximize every inch of wall space, accommodate uneven walls or historic ceiling heights, and incorporate tailored interior features like pull-out spice racks, vertical pan dividers, and built-in trash pullouts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinetry is built to your room's exact dimensions and storage needs, while stock cabinets come in fixed sizes that often require filler strips to fit.
